name: Yaplings
summary: Yaplings is a multiplayer hangout game played between a streamer and their audience. The host wears a VR headset and plays a Giant made of rocks who looks after an island. Viewers join from a free PC client as small creatures and play live during the broadcast: they walk, climb, swim, emote, talk with proximity voice through a voice disguise, and vote for minigames. The Giant can pick creatures up, jail them, launch them and hand out toys.
